title: Sapporo Christmas lottery cancelled after unauthorized access at lottery system provider
summary: ScanNetSecurity reports that Sapporo Station Sogo Kaihatsu cancelled its Christmas lottery "WISH XMAS 2026" after unauthorized access at the provider of the lottery system, found during pre-event testing. The email addresses of employees testing in the test environment may have been viewed by a third party. The company says it could not adequately guarantee customers' personal information and system reliability.
plain: A Sapporo company cancelled its Christmas lottery after unauthorized access at its lottery system provider. Only the email addresses of employee testers may have been seen, according to the report.
exec: A retail operator cancelled a customer event because its system provider was accessed without authorization, according to ScanNetSecurity.
